en.headline: Lee says nurse demand persists and local hires come first
en.dek: The Chief Executive said 99.8 percent of Hospital Authority nurses were locally trained, and that more than 3,000 posts were still vacant.
body: Chief Executive John Lee said on Tuesday that demand for nurses would continue as medical services grow and the population ages, and that public recruitment would keep giving priority to local talent.

Speaking before the Executive Council meeting, Lee said 99.8 percent of nurses now working in the Hospital Authority were locally trained. He said about 40 percent of nurses worked in the public system, and that community elderly and rehabilitation services, as well as private care providers, also needed staff.

He said that among nursing graduates in 2025-26, more than a quarter had applied for jobs outside the Hospital Authority. The authority still had more than 3,000 vacant nurse posts, which graduates could apply for. He added that in every sector some graduates do not look for work immediately, and some applicants are not hired.

Lee said public discussion of nurse hiring should stay focused on medical development and on the service nurses provide. He said the government would keep talking to the sector and to training institutions about manpower planning. He did not give a new hiring target.

zh.headline: 李家超：護士需求長期存在 招聘以本地人才優先
zh.dek: 特首說醫管局現職護士99.8%為本地培訓，目前仍有逾3000個護士空缺可供畢業生申請。
body: 行政長官李家超星期二表示，醫療服務持續增長、人口老化，社會對護士的需求會長期存在，政府招聘會繼續以本地人才優先。
他在行政會議前說，醫管局99.8%的現職護士為本地培訓。現時約四成護士在公營醫療體系工作，社區安老和復康服務，以及私營護理機構，同樣有人手需求。
李家超說，2025至26年度護士畢業生當中，超過四分之一應徵醫管局以外的崗位。醫管局目前仍有3000多個護士職位空缺，畢業生可以申請。他又說，每個行業都會有人畢業後未即時求職，或有個別人士不獲聘用。
他希望各方討論護士招聘時，着眼整體醫療發展和護士對服務的貢獻，共同做好培訓和規劃。政府會繼續與業界和學界就人手發展交換意見。他沒有提出新的招聘目標。
